messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — vendor notified us this morning that their South America region (sa-east1 / partner vendor) has constrained A100 capacity for the next ~10 business days. We need to stand up a short-term demo pool for the POC next week. Can procurement or infra confirm fallback options? :thinking:
kevin: Thanks for flagging. Do we need guaranteed Dedicated GPUs or is a bursty preemptible pool OK for the POC?
maria: For the partner demo we want <50ms tail latency if possible, but throughput is only ~200 rps. If Dedicated isn't available, a mix of reserved h100 in us-east + cross-region routing could work. Prefer not to rely on spots for demo.
olivia: @maria filing a vendor follow-up now. I'm going to ask for a short reserve for 8 A100s or an approval to route to h100 variants. Will post ticket link when created.
jordan: We should also consider temporary autoscale-down safety limits and prefix cache warmup so cold-start tails don't spike. I can add a canary route with smaller batch sizes.
lee: If we end up routing to h100, we need a quick perf check: model quantization profile + kernel selection might change. Suggest a 1-hour smoke bench once we have instances. I can run that.
olivia: Vendor ticket created: https://vendor.example.com/tickets/SA-2026-4123 — asked for short reserve or ETA on A100 replen. cc @procurement.
capacity-bot: current capacity snapshot: sa-east1 A100: 3 available, estimated replen <= 9 days. us-east1 h100: 24 available. (source: vendor sync 1987654300) :bar_chart:
kevin: OK, plan suggestion: 1) Try vendor short reserve for 8 A100s (pending procurement) 2) Prep h100 fallback route and perf bench 3) Canary route to us-east with geo-aware routing and cache priming 4) Communicate latency tradeoffs to partner.
maria: That sounds good. @olivia can you escalate to procurement if vendor won't hold capacity? Also tag @platform-ops for network egress checks for cross-region.
olivia: Yep — pinged procurement (INT-5782) and platform-ops. If vendor can't hold, procurement will approve short-term Dedicated spend for demo.
jordan: I'll start the canary config and leave comments in the PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/infra/pulls/482 — will mark WIP until we know which SKU.
lee: I'll queue bench runs; drop me the instance creds once platform-ops confirms peering.
maria: Great, thanks all. I'll update partner and set expectation window 10 business days. Will re-open if vendor updates earlier. :thumbsup:
